description: This file contains utility functions for system activation and help message generation in an ERP system, including counting records, checking system setup, and providing contextual help messages.

methods.name: get_level
methods.description: Calculates the activation level based on record counts, system setup, email communications, and recent logins.

methods.name: get_help_messages
methods.description: Returns help messages for the desktop interface based on system activation level and domain context.
